cohort: 206 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) using IADPSG criteria, studied at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is associated with higher maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, including preeclampsia, preterm labor, post-partum haemorrhage, shoulder dystocia, stillbirth (IUD), macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, and Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
